metadata.title: Publications
metadata.description: Selected publications grouped by sensing and physical-state inference, transferable and data-efficient skill learning, adaptive control and shared autonomy, and embodiment and actuation design. Journal and conference papers appear alongside clearly labelled preprints.

intro.title: Publications by research theme.
intro.lead: Explore the programme through sensing, learning, adaptive control and physical design. Each paper appears under its main contribution, with connections to related themes shown alongside it.
intro.scope: Selected journal and conference papers, together with clearly labelled preprints. Figures connect each record to its research context; paper and project figures include source links.
